import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
theorem modEq_add_two (a b c d n : ℤ) (_hn : 0 < n) (hab : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]) (hcd : c ≡ d [ZMOD n]) : a + c ≡ b + d [ZMOD n] := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem modEq_add_two (a b c d n : ℤ) (_hn : 0 < n) (hab : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]) (hcd : c ≡ d [ZMOD n]) : a + c ≡ b + d [ZMOD n] :=
by
  have h1 : a - b ≡ 0 [ZMOD n] := hab
  have h2 : c - d ≡ 0 [ZMOD n] := hcd
  have h3 : (a - b) + (c - d) ≡ 0 [ZMOD n] := by rw [h1, h2]
  have h4 : a + c - (b + d) ≡ 0 [ZMOD n] := by
    rw [h3, ZMOD.add_zero]
  exact h4
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.modEq_add_two = Nl2LeanCandidate.modEq_add_two := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.modEq_add_two
